claim: The google-cloud-speech dependency can go: speech recognition runs on gemini-3.5-transcribe through google-genai, nothing in src or tests imports google.cloud.speech, and the app would behave the same without the package (only uv.lock and the stale list at .engine/architecture/architecture-map.md:597 would need updating).

evidence.detail: google-cloud-speech is declared and no module named google_cloud_speech is imported
speech imports google.genai types and builds a genai client at line 121. No google.cloud.speech import exists anywhere in src or tests
the only import of google.cloud.speech_v2 in the repository is in a spike probe outside src, which ruff and mypy exclude
ADR-0005 says the google-cloud-speech package is no longer needed

the fence: the package was kept on purpose because removing it needs the owner's permission, and the owner may still choose to enable speech.googleapis.com and compare against Chirp 3. Both reasons are still open, so the action is confirm and not auto_remove
this is the same finding raised in 404 and 405, and the owner has not answered yet

traceability: none found: no goal or F13 criterion needs google-cloud-speech since ADR-0005. The only reason to keep it is the owner's still-open option to compare against Speech-to-Text v2 (voice-and-language.md:119)
